title: WE PROMOTE FOOTBALL BEING A FOOTBALL LOVER OURSELVES!
author: MFA Sports Team
excerpt: We ourselves love football to core. Official launching of our jersey was done by Former Indian, International and Kerala Blasters FC Player Mr. C.K. VINEETH at Mahe Ground.
content: We ourselves love football to core. And it really helps us to bring new kits as soon as possible. That is the main reason we make sure our prices are reasonable so that every football lover gets a chance to wear their favorite team's jersey once in a life time.

Moreover, we support local football tournaments and matches whenever possible. These are some moments we captured while doing so. We have participated in ALL INDIA SEVENS TOURNAMENT 2023 conducted at Mahe Ground during March. Official launching of our jersey was done by Former Indian, International and Kerala Blasters FC Player Mr. C.K. VINEETH. And we conquered first position too.
We believe AGE IS JUST A NUMBER, especially when it comes to football. Below is our VETERAN's team who never misses a chance to amaze us with their exceptional skills!

We hope Indian football will soon get the recognition and position we deserve. We will keep supporting as far as we could. Even if we couldn't make a position for ourselves, we will make sure our future generation will at least get opportunities to showcase their abilities.
